incidents.name: ANCH token pair-balance skim
incidents.notes: The ANCH token's transfer logic moves tokens out of the liquidity pair's own balance without calling sync(), so the attacker repeatedly skim()ed the surplus and swapped it against the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: ANCH 0xA4f5d4aFd6b9226b3004dD276A9F778EB75f2e9e created 2022-07-22T07:42:43Z by 0xb8a03ef93bc5354c14c385f35a296fd4c34e47ad, unrelated to attack sender 0x7f2f5212bb279c228363b085abf8a689f3475b15; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. No published loss figure, so lossUsd is a conservative onchain bound: the ANCH/USDT pair 0xaD0dA05b9C20fa541012eE2e89AC99A864CC68Bb held 33,144.54 USDT at block 20302530 and 16,900.91 USDT at block 20303000 as the skim was repeated, i.e. 16,243.64 USDT drained in the first minutes of the attack (the balance kept falling to 3,724.69 USDT by block 20340000).
